[ITST.6.2] Checklist for a new impl test:

1. Create `runtime/tests/libds/impl/test_<area>_<scenario>.c`.
2. Include the public API (`libds.h`) and any internal headers the
   scenario needs (e.g. `engine.h` for engine state, `wm.h` for wm
   state).
3. Copy the three helper functions from [ITST.4.1].
4. Write per-scenario static `int` functions per
   [ITST.5.2 / 5.3 / 5.5].
5. Write `main()` per [ITST.5.4 / 5.7].
6. Add a row for the test to the `ImplTest` table in
   `libds.build`. A `test_*.c` with no row is neither built nor
   run.
7. Run the suite on a build host per [ITST.7.1].
